comment: Clips cut from the Sonniss GDC 2026 Game Audio Bundle (sampler, Part 9) into Assets/Hollowmere/Audio by tools/prepare-audio.ps1. 'onset' starts the cut at the Nth detected transient (single bell tolls, knocks); otherwise 'start' in seconds. 'loop' crossfades the end into the start. Output is 48 kHz 16-bit WAV (no ffmpeg on this machine for OGG; Unity compresses to Vorbis on import).
licence: Sonniss GDC Game Audio Bundle licence: royalty-free for commercial and non-commercial projects, no attribution required, not to be redistributed as a sound library (see 'License - GDC Game Audio.pdf' in the bundle)
